Inglewood, California
  October 15, 2019

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, October 15, 2019, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

APPOINTMENT OF MAYOR PRO TEM. It was moved by Council Member
Padilla, and seconded by Council Member Dotson that the City Council does
hereby appoint Council Member Franklin as Mayor Pro Tem for closed session.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Council Members Dotson and Padilla, Mayor Pro Tem Franklin;
Noes: None; and
Absent: Mayor Butts and Council Member Morales.
Mayor Pro Tem Franklin called the City Council/Housing Authority into joint
session for Closed Session at the hour of 1:05 p.m.
The City Clerk/Housing Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as
follows:
  Present:  Mayor Pro Tem/Housing Authority Chairman Pro
  Tem Franklin, Council Members/Housing Authority
  Members Dotson, and Padilla; and
  Absent:  Mayor/Housing Authority Chairman Butts and
  Council Member/Housing Authority Member
  Morales.
City/Housing Authority officials and personnel present for closed session were as
follows:

  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Housing Authority.

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor
Pro Tem/Housing Authority Chairman Pro Tem Franklin inquired if there were
any persons present who wished to address the City Council/Housing Authority
on the Closed Session Items.

There was no response.

Mayor Pro Tem/Housing Authority Chairman Pro Tem Franklin recessed the City
Council/Housing Authority at the hour of 1:07 p.m. for Closed Session Item Nos.
CS-1 & CHS-1 and CS-2 & CHS-2.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called
the City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency and Housing
Authority, at the hour of 2:04 p.m.
The City Clerk/ Successor Agency Secretary/ Housing Authority Secretary
announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing
  Authority  Chairman  Butts,  Council
  Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority Members Dotson, Padilla and Franklin;
  and

  1
 October 15, 2019

  Absent:  Council Member/Successor Agency  Member/
  Housing Authority Member Morales.
  City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
  follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Acting Secretary*
  Wanda Brown  City Treasurer/Treasurer*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/ General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency and Housing Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons
  present who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing
  Authority on any item on the Agenda.

  There was no response.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member
  /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded
  by Council Member /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member
  Dotson that the demands presented to the City Council/Successor
  Agency/Housing Authority dated, October 11, 2019, in the amount of
  $3,304,060.48, are hereby allowed, and the City Clerk/Successor Agency
  Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to certify upon said
  registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by the
  following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority
  Members Dotson, Padilla, Franklin and Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority
  Member Morales.

 178  USE OF UNEXPENDED ASSET FORFEITURE FUNDS AUTHORIZED;
  RESOULTION NO. 20-02 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR
  2019-2020 BUDGET. Staff report dated October 15, 2019, was presented
  recommending authorization to use unexpended Asset Forfeiture Funds to
  complete purchases previously approved in Fiscal Year 2018-2019, and for new
  expenditures.

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member
  Dotson that the City Council does hereby: 1) Authorize use of unexpended
  Asset Forfeiture Funds in the amount of $140,671; 2) Authorize the use of Asset
  Forfeiture Funds in the amount of $360,000 for new expenditures; and 3) Adopt
  Resolution No. 20-02 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA AUTHORIZING THE USE OF $500,671
  IN ASSET FORFEITURE FUNDS FOR POLICE DEPARTMENT
  EXPENDITURERS AND AMENDING THE 2019 – 2020 FISCAL
  YEAR BUDGET

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Morales.

  2
 October 15, 2019

101  PURCHASE AND SALE AGREEMENT NO. 20-009 and 20-009A
  APPROVED – CITY OF INGLEWOOD AND GRAND PACIFIC 7-28 LLC.
  Staff report dated October 15, 2019, was presented recommending approval of a
  Purchase and Sale Agreement between the City of Inglewood and Grand Pacific
  7-28 LLC, to secure 53 square feet of right of way from the larger parcel located
  at 3900 W. Century Boulevard needed to implement the Century Boulevard
  Mobility Improvement Project, subarea 3.

  It was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member
  Franklin that the City Council does hereby Approve Purchase and Sale
  Agreement Nos. 20-009 and 20-009A. The motion was carried by the following
  roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Morales.

  It was moved by Successor Agency Member Padilla, and seconded by Successor
  Agency Member Franklin that the Successor Agency does herby approve the use
  of tax-exempt bond funds in the amount of $12,340 to fund the purchase of the
  property. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Successor Agency Members Dotson, Padilla, Franklin, and Successor
  Agency Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Successor Agency Member Morales.

 142  FISCAL YEAR 2017-2018 FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SINGLE
  AUDIT FOR THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD AND INGLWEOOD
  HOUSING AUTHORITY RECEIVED AND FILED. Staff report dated
  October 15, 2019, presented the Fiscal Year 2017-2018 Financial Statements and
  Single Audit for the City of Inglewood and the Inglewood Housing Authority.

  After receiving an oral presentation by the City’s audit Firm, Lance, Soll &
  Lunghard, LLP, on the City’s Fiscal Year 2017-2018 Basic Financial Statements
  and Single Audit Report on Federal Award, it was moved by Council Member
  Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Padilla that the City Council does
  hereby receive and file the City’s Basic Financial Statements and Single Audit
  Report on Federal Awards for Fiscal Year 2017-2018. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Morales.

  It was moved by Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded by Housing
  Authority Member Padilla that the Housing Authority does hereby receive and
  file the City of Inglewood Basic Financial Statements which includes the Housing
  Authority financial accounts for Fiscal year 2017-2018. The motion was carried
  by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Franklin, and Housing
  Authority Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Housing Authority Member Morales.

 132.6  CLOSED SESSION – CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY
  NEGOTIATORS; PROPERTY LOCATED AT 3552 W. 111TH STREET.

 October 15, 2019

 132.6  CLOSED SESSION – CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY

  MANCHESTER BOULEVARD #354. Closed session – Confidential –
  Conference with Real Property Negotiators: Pursuant to Government Code
  Section 54956.8; Property Location: 3500 West Manchester Boulevard #354,
  Inglewood, CA  90305; City/Authority Negotiator: Artie Fields, City
  Manager/Executive Director; Negotiating Party: Francis J. Lightesy Toliver;
  Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of Payment.

  Discussion held; Direction given to staff.

 101  ORAL REPORTS – CITY MANAGER. Artie Fields, City Manager, stated that
  the Parks and Recreation survey was a success and thanked everyone who
  participated. He stated that the winner of the survey was a resident of District 2.
  Mr. Fields also introduced Lisa Trifiletti of Trifiletti Consulting who presented a
  power point presentation on the progress of the Inglewood Transit Procurement
  Project Delivery approach.

 127  ORAL REPORTS – CITY CLERK. Yvonne Horton, City Clerk, stated the
  County Registrar-Recorder’s Office will be in her office with the new Voter
  Solutions device the first week of December, and invited everyone to try out the
  new machine and also give their feedback.

 219  ORAL REPORTS – CITY TREASURER. Wanda Brown, City Treasurer
  reminded everyone that the Student Treasurer’s Academy Program will be
  starting November 6, 2019, and encouraged parents to get their children signed
  up.
 127.2  COUNCIL INITIATIVE
  Council Member Dotson:
  Initiative by Council Member George W. Dotson, District No. 1, requesting
  approval of City Sponsorship for the 7th Annual District 1 Toy Drive Celebration
  to be held on Wednesday, December 11, 2019, from 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m., at the
  Inglewood Senior Center located at 111 N. Locust Street.
  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member
  Padilla that the City Council does hereby approve City Sponsorship. The motion
  was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Morales.

  PUBLIC REMARKS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present
  who wished to address the City Council on any matter connected with City
  business not elsewhere considered on the Agenda.

  There was no response.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the
  meeting adjourned at the hour of 2:29 p.m.

  Approved this 29th day of October, 2019

  _________________________
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
